source_document: Concentric Security Group LEO Ground Station Market Opportunity Assessment (Mar 2026)

postdiction_queue.prediction: Amazon Kuiper will deploy at least 1,000 of its planned 3,236 satellites by end of 2026
postdiction_queue.rationale: FCC deadline Jul 2026 for half constellation. Concentric assessment confirms active deployment trajectory.

postdiction_queue.prediction: Telesat Lightspeed will have launched at least 50 satellites by end of 2027
postdiction_queue.rationale: SpaceX launches from mid-2026. 188-satellite initial deployment. Concentric identifies as actively seeking GS partners.

postdiction_queue.prediction: Microsoft will not re-enter the GSaaS market within 3 years of exiting (by Oct 2027)
postdiction_queue.rationale: Concentric assessment: Microsoft concluded ownership too capital-intensive and operationally specialised. Market favours dedicated operators.

postdiction_queue.prediction: At least one additional VC-backed GSaaS operator will be acquired by a defence contractor in 2026-2027
postdiction_queue.rationale: Atlas/York acquisition sets precedent. Concentric assessment identifies GSaaS as scaling faster than security capability.

postdiction_queue.prediction: KSAT Hyper space-based relay will achieve initial operating capability by end of 2028
postdiction_queue.rationale: Concentric identifies as 'potential game-changer' but in-orbit ground station tech is unproven at scale. Moved to chances_about_even from original likely.

postdiction_queue.prediction: Starlink will exceed 14M subscribers by end of 2027
postdiction_queue.rationale: Concentric projects 14M by 2030. Faster growth trajectory (10M Feb 2026) suggests 14M potential ahead of schedule.

postdiction_queue.prediction: Total global ground stations will exceed 800 by end of 2027 (from ~500 in 2025/26)
postdiction_queue.rationale: Concentric projects 1,000+ by 2030 from ~500 in 2025/26. Kuiper alone plans 300+ new stations.

postdiction_queue.prediction: Neither Chinese mega-constellation (Guowang 12,992 sats / Qianfan 14,000 sats) will achieve 500 operational satellites by end of 2028
postdiction_queue.rationale: Qianfan has 18 launched to date. Guowang initial launches expected 2026. 12K-14K satellite deployments at Chinese production rates.

investment_thesis_frames.model: Per-site security assessment, ongoing monitoring, guard force and hardening services. Recurring revenue per station per year.
priority_targets: Leaf Space (20+ locations, VC-backed, scaling into high-risk geographies)
Skynopy (French, 20+ sites, expanding to overseas territories)
key_signals: GSaaS operator announces expansion into politically unstable region
GSaaS operator reports security incident at remote site
Insurance market increases premium for ground station coverage

investment_thesis_frames.model: Site-specific physical risk surveys for Lloyd's space underwriting syndicates. Fee per survey, commissioned via specialist brokers.
priority_targets: Aon International Space Brokers (35% global premium share)
key_signals: Lloyd's syndicate expands space underwriting capacity
Major ground station incident triggers insurance claim
New regulatory requirements for physical security certifications

investment_thesis_frames.model: Identify, secure, and lease hardened ground station sites in strategically valuable locations. Landlord model with security wrapper. Longer-term capital commitment, higher margin.
priority_targets: Amazon/Kuiper (300+ stations needed, regulatory mandate for in-country sites)
key_signals: New regulatory mandate requiring in-country ground stations
Constellation operator announces ground station RFP for specific region
Satellite operator seeks local site partner for market entry
